versions.name: Archive workspace paths
versions.description: Pack workspace paths into a tar.gz archive with a sha256 checksum — pair with buz/oss-upload or buz/s3-upload to publish it.
versions.description_zh: 将 workspace 中的路径打包为 tar.gz 归档并生成 sha256 校验和——配合 buz/oss-upload 或 buz/s3-upload 发布。
versions.author: buz maintainers

versions.name: Archive workspace paths
versions.description: Two modes. pack (default, Runner workspace) — pack workspace paths into a tar.gz archive with a sha256 checksum; pair with buz/oss-upload or buz/scp-upload to publish it. extract (engine: ssh, target hosts) — unpack a tar.gz into an absolute directory on each target host; pair with buz/scp-upload for the delivery leg. Requires tar on the target hosts.
versions.description_zh: 两种模式。pack(默认，Runner 工作区)——将 workspace 路径打包为 tar.gz 并生成 sha256 校验和;extract(engine: ssh，目标主机)——在目标主机上将 tar.gz 解包到绝对目录。需要目标机装有 tar。
versions.author: buz maintainers
